title: Our First Harvest: Storing and Preserving Tips
author: Miguel Torres
content: Our first harvest of the year is in! We are sharing tips on storing and preserving fresh produce so it lasts longer, along with a few of our favorite recipes for using it up. Zucchini and summer squash are coming in fast, so we've been freezing shredded batches for winter soups and pickling the smaller ones for a quick snack.
